subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this exact macOS Swift dependency bump, including Peekaboo 3.7.0 for the UI automation bridge and Sparkle 2.9.4 for the updater?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct and exact-head checks are green, but the changed production dependencies sit on UI automation and update-delivery boundaries where maintainer risk acceptance is required.

options.title: Accept After Mac Owner Review
options.body: Merge after a Mac app owner reviews the upstream release changes and accepts the exact-head CI/security checks as sufficient for this dependency bump.

options.title: Require Signed-App Smoke Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a signed macOS app smoke verifies startup, Sparkle availability, and Peekaboo bridge enable/disable behavior with the bumped dependencies.

options.title: Defer This Dependency Batch
options.body: Pause or close this Dependabot PR if maintainers want Peekaboo or Sparkle upgrades handled in a release-owned dependency batch.

recommendation.title: Accept After Mac Owner Review
recommendation.body: Merge after a Mac app owner reviews the upstream release changes and accepts the exact-head CI/security checks as sufficient for this dependency bump.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the embedded Peekaboo bridge and macOS app runtime surfaces most affected by this bump.
